title: Students and Careers
text:
Many young people want to go to university. They study for several years to learn a job. Some students choose engineering, and others choose medicine or teaching. Education helps people find good careers.

Maria is a nurse in a big hospital. She studied nursing for four years at a college. Now she helps patients every day. She likes her job because she can help people.

questions.text: How long do students study to learn a job?
How long did Maria study nursing?
What can we infer about Maria's job?
options: It is boring and she wants to leave
It is far from her home

questions.text: Why do many young people go to university?
options: They want to find good careers
They want to live in a hospital
They do not want to work

vocabulary.definition: jobs that people do for a long part of their life
a person who takes care of sick people
a place where sick people receive medical treatment

paragraph_translations: Muitos jovens querem ir para a universidade. Eles estudam por vários anos para aprender uma profissão. Alguns alunos escolhem engenharia, e outros escolhem medicina ou ensino. A educação ajuda as pessoas a encontrar boas carreiras.
Maria é enfermeira em um hospital grande. Ela estudou enfermagem por quatro anos em uma faculdade. Agora ela ajuda pacientes todos os dias. Ela gosta do seu trabalho porque pode ajudar as pessoas.
